I have looked at using prerender.io for shiny apps, but haven't actually implemented it.  Since I'm using nginx as a web server for static content and as a reverse proxy server in front of my Shiny apps, I would likely use an nginx.conf configuration similar to the prerender.io officially-maintained solution here:  https://gist.github.com/thoop/8165802

If you're using Apache, ExpressJS, etc. there are similar solutions to peruse at: https://prerender.io/documentation
